ns2:section.sectionText: Be sure to enroll in your desired credit amount for this variable credit course (2 or 4 hours). The registration system will input 2 hours by default so if you want to enroll for 4 hours you will need to change it. Required overnight field trip April 18-19. A non-waived field trip fee of $100 will be assessed to tuition and fees bill. The students will also be responsible for the cost of their meals and one night's lodging. Questions may be directed to the instructor (fschlipf@illinois.edu).
